chapter_title_en: The Great Teleportation Token and the Ancient Teleportation Array
chapter_seo_title: The Great Teleportation Token – Han Li’s Escape Route from a Wartorn Sect
chapter_meta_description: Han Li returns to Yellow Maple Valley and discovers the extraordinary nature of the blue token he found—a Great Teleportation Token that could send him millions of li away from the war.
og_title: Han Li Finds His Getaway Ticket – A Great Teleportation Token
og_description: After surviving the Blood Forbidden Land, Han Li deciphers the secret of the ancient teleportation array and plots his escape from the Seven Sects war.
twitter_title: Han Li just found a one-way ticket out of a war zone—if he can fix the ancient teleportation array.
twitter_description: The blue token isn’t just treasure. It’s an ancient safety net that could teleport Han Li across the continent.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient artifact required to survive ultra-long-distance teleportation. The knowledge to create them has been lost, making existing tokens priceless relics.
A primordial formation capable of sending a cultivator millions of *li* in an instant. Their construction is a lost art, and surviving examples are practically unheard of in Tiannan.
Innate aptitude for cultivation; without one, a person cannot absorb spiritual qi. The presence or lack of a root determines one’s entire fate in the cultivation world.
A rare concentration of liquid spiritual energy formed over tens of thousands of years, capable of accelerating cultivation and nurturing spirit beast eggs.
The mid-tier stage of the Foundation Establishment realm, marking a significant step up in mana capacity and life-force; it also counts as greater combat survivability.
Han Li’s personal flying artifact, fast but fragile; a symbol of his pragmatic resource management.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does the Great Teleportation Token do?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It protects the user from the crushing spatial pressure generated during ultra-long-distance teleportation. Without it, even a powerful cultivator would be torn apart.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Han Li just flee the sect to avoid the war?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Seven Sects Executionary Squad would hunt him for life. He calculates that staying inside the beast’s mouth is safer than becoming a permanent fugitive.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Are ancient teleportation arrays common in this world?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. They are legendary lost technology; modern cultivators can only build arrays spanning a few hundred *li*, not millions.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the “Foundation Establishment middle stage” breakthrough?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Azure Origin Sword Art’s fifth layer advancing alongside the Great Derivative Art’s first layer triggered a simultaneous breakthrough, pushing him to a new tier of power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Does Han Li fix the ancient teleportation array in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not yet. He searches for repair methods and finds nothing—but he remembers someone who might be able to help.
